title: Salem High School
subtitle: NYC February 12-15, 2027
bodyHtml:
Families, you are currently viewing a sample itinerary customized for Salem High School. Please note that this version is meant to provide a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As we get closer to departure, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates. For now, please enjoy this preview of what is planned for your student’s upcoming trip.

Day 1: Metropolitan Museum of Art & Times Square

  • Travel to NYC!
  • Lunch 
  • Self-guided tour of The Metropolitan Museum of Art
  • Visit the Institute of Culinary Education
  • Group Exploration of Times Square
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Hotel Accommodations with overnight security (three nights)
 

Day 2: Flavors of Chinatown Food Tour & Broadway Show

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Take the Staten Island Ferry
  • Flavors of Chinatown Food Tour
  • Free time in small groups 
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Watch a Broadway Show
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations
 

Day 3: Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum & Central Park

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Guided tour of Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum
  • Lunch 
  • Landmark Leader Led Walking Tour of Central Park
  • Free time
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Visit the Empire State Building Observation Deck
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations 
 

Day 4: Whitney Museum of American Art & Departure

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the Whitney Museum of American Art 
  • Lunch at Chelsea Market
  • Chelsea Market, Hudson Yards, The High Line; Group Exploration
  • Departure Home
introHeading: Salem High School, get ready for an unforgettable NYC adventure in 2027! 🗽
introText: From world-famous museums and iconic landmarks to vibrant neighborhoods and unforgettable performances, this New York City experience brings art, culture, and excitement to life at every turn. Students will explore destinations like the Metropolitan Museum of Art and the Guggenheim, discover the energy of Times Square and Central Park, and enjoy breathtaking views from the Empire State Building. With hands-on experiences, delicious local flavors, and the magic of a Broadway show, this trip is the perfect mix of learning, culture, and adventure—an experience your students will never forget!
